mapper.select: select count(1) from article_favorites where article_id = #{articleId}
select count(1) from comments where article_id = #{articleId}
select coalesce(sum(view_count), 0) from article_views where article_id = #{articleId}

select A.id, A.slug, A.title, count(AF.user_id) as favoriteCount from articles A inner join article_favorites AF on A.id = AF.article_id where AF.article_id in ( select article_id from article_favorites where article_id in ( select id from articles where created_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days') ) ) and A.created_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days') group by A.id, A.slug, A.title order by favoriteCount desc limit 10
